title: Build NextHire AI landing page

requirements.text: Create a hero section with a strong headline promoting NextHire AI as an AI-powered resume builder, a compelling subheadline, and a primary call-to-action button
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays a prominent headline about NextHire AI
Section includes a descriptive subheadline
Primary CTA button is clearly visible

requirements.text: Create a features section showcasing three key capabilities: AI resume builder, ATS checker, and job tracker, each with an icon, title, and description

quotes: Features section (AI resume builder, ATS checker, job tracker)

acceptanceCriteria: Features section displays three distinct features
Each feature includes an icon, title, and description
Content specifically covers AI resume builder, ATS checker, and job tracker

requirements.text: Create a 'How it works' section explaining the user journey in 3-4 steps with visual hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Section presents a clear step-by-step process
Each step is numbered and includes a description
Visual hierarchy guides users through the flow

requirements.text: Create a pricing section with at least three pricing tiers (e.g., Free, Pro, Enterprise) including features list and CTA buttons for each tier
acceptanceCriteria: Pricing section displays multiple pricing tiers
Each tier shows price, features list, and a CTA button
Tiers are visually distinct with clear hierarchy

requirements.text: Create a testimonials section with at least three customer testimonials, each including a quote, customer name, and role/company
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials section displays multiple customer quotes
Each testimonial includes quote text, customer name, and role/company
Testimonials are presented in a visually appealing layout

requirements.text: Create an FAQ section with at least 5-6 common questions and answers in an expandable/collapsible format
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ section displays multiple questions
Questions are expandable/collapsible to show/hide answers
At least 5-6 relevant questions are included

requirements.text: Create a call-to-action section with email signup form that captures user email addresses and includes a submit button

quotes: Call to action with email signup

acceptanceCriteria: CTA section includes an email input field
Section includes a submit button
Form validates email format before submission
Backend stores submitted email addresses

requirements.text: Apply a blue and white color theme throughout the landing page with clean, minimal, and professional styling that reflects a modern startup aesthetic

quotes: Use blue and white color theme
Make it clean, minimal, and professional
Make it look like a startup website

acceptanceCriteria: Primary color palette uses blue and white
Design is clean and minimal with appropriate whitespace
Overall aesthetic matches modern SaaS startup websites
Typography and spacing create a professional appearance

requirements.text: Render generated images as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated for any visual elements created for the landing page
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are stored in frontend/public/assets/generated
Images are referenced correctly in the React components
Images load properly in the browser

constraints: Use React with TypeScript for frontend implementation
Maintain blue and white color theme throughout
Follow single-actor Motoko architecture for backend
